note: Recipe index built from cookbook table-of-contents OR index-page photos. SAMPLE DATA below is placeholder so the app isn't empty on first load - replace with real cookbooks. Fields: cookbook.source is 'toc' or 'index' (provenance); recipe.page is a number or a range string ('112-114'); recipe.chapter and recipe.keywords are optional. keywords come from index pages (the categories/ingredients a recipe was listed under) and are stored now so ingredient search can be added later without re-reading photos. Within a cookbook, each recipe is stored once per (title + page); the app also dedupes defensively and merges keywords.
